 Updated Nov. 19, 2026, 9:40 p.m. ET First lady Melania Trump walked the red carpet on Nov. 19 at Alice Tully Hall in New York City at the premiere of "Melania, The Series," a new two-part docuseries arriving on Prime Video on Friday, Nov. 20.
It serves as a follow-up to the "Melania" documentary film released in January, which chronicled the weeks leading up to the inauguration.
